newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PERSETEL UP ON Q DATA BUY RUMOURS.
newsitem.headline: PERSETEL UP ON Q DATA BUY RUMOURS.

text.p: Shares in information technology firm Persetel Holdings Ltd sparked up in Tuesday morning trade on the back of market speculation the company was poised e a controlling stake in Q Data Ltd.
At 0955 GMT, Persetel shares were up 125 cents to 26.85 rand on turnover of 726,700 shares.
"There's been good speculation that Persetel will acquire a controlling stake in Q Data which would be a good thing for the group," said one broker.
Tuesday's local Business Day newspaper quoted highly placed sources as saying a deal was on the cards following the exit of Q Data chairman Piet den Boer.
"Persetel was likely to purchase a controlling stake in Q Data -- possibly from Siltek Ltd -- which owns 41 percent of the company -- but a merger of the groups was not excluded," the paper said.
Q Data and Siltek stocks have jumped as well, up 28 cents to 872 cents and up 150 cents to 23 rand respectively.
Persetel and Siltek representatives were not immediately available for comment.
